scope: Three real veneers/common producer, actual C connection getters and memcpy; envelope bytes, allocation rounding/overflow requests, unsigned occupancy arithmetic, logs, mutable queue/thread handles, timeout, wake and cleanup
limitations: Heap, CMSIS queue/flags and log providers are intercepted; no BLE worker executes.
Large length overflow cases force allocation failure; successful oversized copies are not exercised.
Only 16-byte task-context prefixes are owned; task creator/stopper bodies and complete private state remain open.
Original instruction identity and physical transport remain unproven.
